role: first independent EOG-WF forecast validation after algorithm merge

source.dataset_name: DataSTOC / French Breeding Bird Survey STOC biomod2 example
source.transport_rule: Use the immutable official biomod2 GitHub tag/path. No alternate data version after response rows are inspected.

metadata_only_eligibility.reason: The public documentation declares paired periods, 1003 georeferenced sites, six environmental predictors, and 20 bird responses in one fixed source.

response_semantics.raw_response: yearly average headcount within each declared multi-year period
response_semantics.interpretation: survey-period detection/record at a fixed STOC site, not latent biological occupancy probability
response_semantics.negative_class: raw_response == 0 within the published STOC period aggregate
response_semantics.missing_response: exclude that species-site-period pair; do not coerce to zero

temporal_design.heldout_outcomes_must_remain_unread_unti: all source, schema, world, anchor, comparator, metric and stop rules below are committed and tests are green
temporal_design.generalisation_target: future-period observed presence at the same fixed monitoring sites

site_and_input_gate.coordinate_rule: finite WGS84 coordinates, identical for the paired rows of each site
site_and_input_gate.predictor_rule: all six declared predictors finite for both period rows

species_estimability_rule.population: all 20 published DataSTOC species; no species selected by EOG-WF performance
species_estimability_rule.rule_timing: thresholds frozen before response rows are opened

world_universe.uncertainty_type: analyst-choice sensitivity universe; not calibrated bird dispersal/tolerance parameters
world_universe.coordinate_distance: pairwise Haversine distance among the 1003 fixed sites
world_universe.environment_distance: Euclidean distance after calibration-period z-standardisation of the six declared predictors
world_universe.geographic_threshold_rule: q25, q50, q75, q90 of each site's nearest-neighbour geographic distance distribution
world_universe.environment_threshold_rule: q25, q50, q75, q90 of nearest-neighbour environmental-distance distribution, using the same calibration-period sites
world_universe.edge_rule_geography_only: directed symmetric edge i<->j when geographic distance <= geographic threshold
world_universe.edge_rule_geo_environment: directed symmetric edge i<->j when geographic distance <= geographic threshold AND environmental distance <= environmental threshold
world_universe.edge_support: 1 for admitted edge components, 0 otherwise; dynamic operator loss_support fixed at 1.0
world_universe.coverage_claim: All robustness/exclusion statements are conditional only on these 20 declared sensitivity worlds.

anchor_and_reconstruction_policy.calibration_positive_pool: sites with observed_in_period=1 in 2006-2011 for the species
anchor_and_reconstruction_policy.anchor_rule: select up to 10 calibration-positive anchor sites by deterministic farthest-first geographic traversal; seed is the lexicographically smallest site ID; if fewer than 10 positives exist the species is already non-estimable by the species gate
anchor_and_reconstruction_policy.compatibility_targets: all remaining calibration-positive sites not selected as anchors
anchor_and_reconstruction_policy.world_survival_rule: a world survives only when every compatibility target has positive first-passage support from the frozen anchors within max_steps=8
anchor_and_reconstruction_policy.forecast_source_rule: heldout forecast propagation uses all 2006-2011 calibration-positive sites as realized sources inside each surviving world; these sources are conditioning information, not inferred ancestry

forecast_contract.viability_gate: none in the primary test; environmental effects are already represented as declared world-edge alternatives and external SDM comparators

same_world_compressions: mean cumulative reachability support across surviving worlds
external: period-1 persistence baseline: heldout prediction equals 2006-2011 observed_in_period
environment-only L2 logistic SDM on the six calibration-period predictors
environment-only random-forest SDM on the six calibration-period predictors
fixed equal-weight mean of logistic and random-forest predicted probabilities
comparators.hyperparameter_rule: no heldout tuning; logistic C=1.0, random forest n_estimators=500 max_features='sqrt' min_samples_leaf=5 random_state=20260817
comparators.scaling_rule: fit transformations on calibration period only

primary_endpoints.prediction_metric: species-macro heldout binary log loss on 2012-2017 observed_in_period
primary_endpoints.eog_scalar_for_logloss: supporting_world_fraction at horizon 8, clipped only numerically to [1e-6, 1-1e-6] for log loss
primary_endpoints.identity_preserving_endpoint: within equal supporting-world-frequency collision groups, test whether exact supporting-world identity partitions heldout positives more sharply than frequency alone using a predeclared one-hot world-vector logistic extension fitted only on calibration-derived pseudo-target structure is forbidden; therefore the first independent endpoint is descriptive hit enrichment by exact support sets, not an additional fitted outcome model
primary_endpoints.spatial_summary_units: 10 coordinate-only k-means blocks with random_state=20260817, frozen without heldout response; report block effects descriptively

predictive_added_value_favourable_only_i: species-macro EOG-WF log loss is lower than supporting-world-frequency compression baseline if that baseline differs from the EOG scalar implementation
species-macro EOG-WF log loss is lower than the fixed external ensemble comparator
EOG-WF is not worse than the persistence baseline
at least 60% of estimable species favour EOG-WF over the fixed external ensemble
decision_rules.independent_identity_value: may be labelled supported only if exact support-set identity shows predeclared heldout enrichment beyond equal-frequency collisions without outcome-tuned regrouping

forbidden_after_response_open: change world count or threshold quantiles
change anchor count or farthest-first rule
change prediction metric or favourable rule
reinterpret zero counts as latent biological absence
add a new dataset to rescue an adverse result
